gold.user: As a project manager, I want to retrieve the details of a specific task by its ID so that I can review its status and assigned resources.
gold.ideal: The response should include the task ID, title, description, status, assignee, and any comments associated with the task.

gold.user: As a team lead, I need to cancel a task that is no longer relevant to our project goals, ensuring that all stakeholders are informed of this change.
gold.ideal: The response should confirm the cancellation of the task and provide any relevant information regarding the next steps or reassignment of resources.
